title: DOW-UAP-D12, Mission Report, Iraq, May 2022
doc_notes: This is a declassified military mission report (MISREP) from the Department of War regarding an aerial reconnaissance flight in Iraq, which includes a brief section documenting a UAP sighting.

encounters.summary: An unidentified aerial phenomenon was observed by an aircraft screener moving north to north-east; the object could not be positively identified.
encounters.quote: SCREENER COULD NOT GET A POSITIVE ID ON THE UAP
